dct_description_sm:
====DATA DICTIONARY====
Station (Alphabetical) - Station Identification:
    Dense Plateau - a station on a densely forested plateau
    Sparse plateau - a station on a sparsely forested plateau
    Intermediate Plateau - a station on a plateau with intermediate forest density
    Wetland - a station in a wetland with no forest cover
Year - Date variable
Month - Date variable
Day - Date variable
K_In_Daily - Daily Incoming Shortwave Radiation measured in MJ/m2
K_Out_Daily - Daily Outgoing Shortwave Radiation measured in MJ/m2
L_In_Daily - Daily Incoming Longwave Radiation measured in MJ/m2
L_Out_Daily - Daily Outgoing Longwave Radiation measured in MJ/m2
Date - Date variable. Collected by instrument


====VERSION LOG====
1.0 - 20210616 - New, Published Dataset.

This dataset includes data for the manuscript entitled, "Long-term climate-influenced land cover change in discontinuous permafrost peatland complexes”. This study combines extensive geomatics data with ground-based meteorological and hydrological measurements to inform a new conceptual model of landscape evolution that accounts for the observed patterns of permafrost thaw-induced landcover change, and provides a basis for predicting future changes. Included here are four component radiation data from four sites, each representing a stage of landscape evolution. Specifically, incoming shortwave, outgoing shortwave, incoming longwave, and outgoing longwave radiation were measured (W/m2) at 30-minute intervals beginning as early as 2004 and continuing through 2019. The four sites instrumented and included in this dataset are: a densely forested plateau site (2007-2019), a sparsely forested plateau site (2015-2018), an intermediate forested plateau site (2014-2019), and a wetland site with no forest cover (2004-2019). Details of instrumentation are included in the aforementioned manuscript.
